blocks.heading: Why Maruti Gypsy Outperforms for Tiger Tracking
blocks.intro: Ranthambore's terrain is renowned for rocky plateaus, dry deciduous forests, and river beds. The compact 4x4 Maruti Gypsy can navigate tight corners where tigers often stalk chital deer, giving you front-row vantage points impossible in larger vehicles.

items.title: Agile Forest Maneuvering
items.text: When fresh tiger pugmarks or deer alarm calls echo through the valley, drivers can quickly reverse and redirect into narrow ravines without disturbing the wildlife.

items.title: Eye-Level Photography Angles
items.text: Unlike buses with elevated views, the Gypsy sits low enough to capture dramatic eye-level portraits of big cats, sloths, and leopards against the ancient Banyan trees.

items.title: Silent Engine Stalking
items.text: Lightweight petrol engines create minimal vibrations, allowing birds, crocodiles, and deer herds to continue their natural behaviors undisturbed.

blocks.heading: Government ID & Boarding Checklist
blocks.intro: Follow these Rajasthan Forest Department guidelines strictly.

items.title: 1. Carry Exact Original ID
items.text: The Forest Ranger at the gate matches original Aadhaar / Passport with the printed permit voucher. No photocopies or phone images permitted.

items.title: 2. Stay Inside Vehicle at All Times
items.text: Alighting from the Gypsy inside the core reserve is strictly prohibited and carries severe government fines.

items.title: 3. Neutral Color Clothing
items.text: Wear khaki, olive green, beige, or brown. Bright neon colors disturb territorial animals.

items.title: 4. No Plastic & No Drones
items.text: Ranthambore is a zero-plastic zone. Drones and flash photography are illegal under the Wildlife Protection Act.

blocks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions (Maruti Gypsy)
blocks.intro: Got queries before reserving your Gypsy? Here are quick answers.

items.q: How many people can sit in a Maruti Gypsy?
items.a: The Maruti Gypsy accommodates a maximum of 6 tourists per vehicle, plus 1 registered Rajasthan Forest Department naturalist guide and 1 authorized park driver.

items.q: Can we choose our preferred safari zone in a Gypsy?
items.a: You can submit your preference for Core Zones (1 to 5) or Buffer Zones (6 to 10) at the time of enquiry. The Rajasthan Forest Department allocation software assigns final zones based on daily quota availability.

items.q: Are children charged full price for a Gypsy seat?
items.a: Children aged 5 years and above require a full seat and permit. Children under 5 years of age can travel on parent lap free of government park entry fees, but original ID must still be presented.

items.q: What should we carry during the Gypsy safari?
items.a: You must carry the exact original Government Photo ID (Aadhaar/Passport) used during booking, warm layers for winter mornings, UV sunglasses, dust mask/scarf, and camera gear with dust covers.

blocks.title: Only 48 Gypsy Permits Available Per Shift
blocks.text: Govt quotas for core zones (Zones 1-5) often book out 60 to 90 days in advance. Speak with our Sawai Madhopur booking desk today to lock in your dates.
